scope: Windows x64 Node 24.18.0 loopback HTTP and fingerprinted raw DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 temporary-directory fixtures; no phone/user data/model calls

items.current: No response-body buffering. Every write delegates to native Node with its encoding, callback and returned backpressure. Only a complete synchronous end(data) JSON body between 4 KiB and 1 MiB can compress; staged headers are released after one event-loop turn or immediately on write/flushHeaders. SSE, HEAD, no-body statuses, explicit chunking/encoding, strong byte validators, strict Content-Length, oversized bodies and q=0 remain native.

items.current: Capture the exact public AgentHandle at rc2 agents.create/resume, including traced Cordis consumers. Delete live sessions only after cancel, awaited whenIdle, sessions.flush returning true, complete handle.dispose and public registry absence checks. Reject unknown capabilities or failed/unfinished lifecycle operations with 409 and retain originals. Guard concurrent same-id creation/resume/deletion. Retain logs under the persistence root .sessions-trash with manifest; no TTL or automatic rm. Detect symlink/unknown-suffix conflicts and restore earlier payload names when a move fails. Workspace errors are reported as explicit warnings after retained deletion.
